summary: Boost Run Inc. filed an 8-K solely to disclose entry into a material definitive agreement — a Master Services Agreement and two Order Forms with Thinking Machines Lab Inc. This is a commercial contract for the rental of 5,000 NVIDIA B300 GPU servers over 36 months with a total contract value of ~$471.7 million. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or any other special-situation event. The agreement is a routine customer contract for services, not a corporate event requiring classification under any special-situations category. There are no deal terms, premiums, advisors, or structural changes to the company's equity or corporate structure.
